decisions.rationale: Replace the capacity-only minute table with a per-day block allocation for every Standard and Fast day in this course. It states which topic page, quiz, video, lab or project activity fills each fixed calendar block. Each planned lab gets a duration, and each day total is checked against its frozen block template under the merged budget rule. Keep every frozen topic and block. Report any day that cannot fit as an overflow; do not drop content.

Smallest compliant option, with no new lab. Map the project-setup objective o1 to a named, authentic learner-side setup step: the first step of the S27 project (Standard) and the equivalent step at the start of the Fast direct-project work. The page simulator stays as preparation. Record the mapping in intake.md and in the topic applicability.

Accepted with a scope limit. The confirmed coverage matrix gives this topic no lab overlay, so no lab is added. Instead the topic page includes an authentic local-browser practice step: the learner opens a small provided buggy HTML/JS file in real Chrome or Firefox DevTools, sets a line and a conditional breakpoint, steps, watches values and fixes the fault, with the simulator used for preparation. Rewrite the objectives so each one is evidenced by that page activity, the simulator or the formative quiz. Record this in applicability.
Revise o1 to contrast JavaScript's dynamic typing and its Number/BigInt numeric primitives with Java's static numeric types.
Reword o1: the browser restricts frontend JavaScript from reading a cross-origin response unless CORS permits it, and only requests outside the CORS-safelisted conditions trigger a preflight.

The confirmed coverage matrix is the artifact-scope authority. Remove the extra S23 javascript-fundamentals module lab from the lab plan and leave the S23 rows as matrix-defined: page, text alternative, simulator, quiz and conditional video.
Add the versioned official Node 22 node:test and global fetch documentation to source-snapshot.json with current receipts and the sections used.
Change o1 to require an associated visible label for each visible user-input control (labelable data-entry input), and teach accessible names for controls with different semantics.
